description: Get user's tweet timeline. Tweet timeline of a user by numeric user ID. The list is inside `data.tweets`. Paginated: use `cursor` / `next_cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page, then pass `next_cursor` from the previous response.

includeParentTweet.description: Include the parent tweet of replies (`true` / `false`).

name: x_user_tweet_timeline
